  Scenario: AC6 The rules of section 8 with no criterion are asserted by their owner and never changed by the harness (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given each rule of section 8 names a covering criterion here or an owner
    When the run reads the criteria and the owners' results for the rules of section 8
    Then every rule is asserted by the criterion or the owner named in section 8
    And the harness changes none of BR1 to BR8

  Scenario: AC7 A consumed call that fails or does not answer stops the cost approval and is reported as a gap (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the partner read, the instruction read or the asset read does not answer within the 2 s budget, or answers with a failure
    When the cost approval is taken through POST /api/recovery/partner/v1/partner/instructions/{instructionId}/results
    Then no claim is recorded against the instruction and no decision entry is written
    And the missing answer is reported as a gap in the evidence, never as a pass
